# Two live actors, deterministic action order within a frame.
interest radius 1
flight on
teleport 8.5 221.5 8.5
give Cobblestone 3
player create
interest radius 1
flight on
teleport 8.5 221.5 8.5
give Cobblestone 3
wait 4

# ID 2 wins the placement. The losing actor keeps all three items.
placeSelected 8 220 8
expect result Ok
expect revision 2
expect inventory 0 Cobblestone 2
player select 1
placeSelected 8 220 8
expect result WorldRejected
expect revision 2
expect inventory 0 Cobblestone 3
expect voxel 8 220 8 Cobblestone

# ID 2 also wins the break, but both actors can pick up the drop.
# Ascending PlayerId gives the shared drop to ID 1.
player select 2
break 8 220 8
expect result Ok
expect item 1 Cobblestone 1
player select 1
break 8 220 8
expect result WorldRejected
expect revision 3
expect voxel 8 220 8 air
expect items 1
wait 40
expect items 0
expect inventory 0 Cobblestone 4

# Two drops from the same slot create just one entity. Six cobblestone
# are still accounted for: four in inventories and two in the world.
player select 2
expect inventory 0 Cobblestone 2
drop 2
expect result Ok
drop 2
expect result EmptyStack
expect inventory 0 empty 0
expect items 1
expect item 2 Cobblestone 2

# Retiring ID 2 discards its private inventory, selection and commands.
# ID 3 joins fresh. Only ID 1 gets horizontal walking input after rejoin.
give Dirt 1
select 5
move -1 0
jump
player remove 2
expect inventory 0 Cobblestone 4
teleport 8.5 225 8.5
flight off
expect result Ok
move 1 0
sprint on
player create
expect inventory 0 empty 0
expect inventory 5 empty 0
interest radius 1
teleport 12.5 225 8.5
wait 5
expect items 1
expect item 2 Cobblestone 2
